tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all post categories with their slugs and counts.

tools.name: get_llms_txt
tools.description: Return the structured llms.txt context for the whole site — lets agents understand what the site is about at a glance. Requires Mescio for Agents.

variant.description: "index" for the summary (default) or "full" for the complete content.

tools.name: get_markdown_content
tools.description: Retrieve a published post or page as clean Markdown — ideal for AI consumption. Requires Mescio for Agents.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Return the items of a navigation menu.

menu.description: Menu name, slug, or ID (default: primary).

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Retrieve a single post or page by ID or slug.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Return basic site metadata (name, description, URL, language).

tools.name: retrieve
tools.description: RAG retrieve: search published site content and return ranked hits with snippets, Markdown URLs and token estimates. Use this before get_markdown_content. Requires Mescio for Agents.

post_type.description: Optional post type slug (post, page, product, …).

include_content.description: If true, attach truncated Markdown for each hit (default: false).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search posts, pages or custom post types on the site.

tools.name: submit_contact_form
tools.description: Submit a Contact Form 7 form programmatically.

fields.description: Key-value pairs matching the form field names.
